scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 63 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Prehistoric Pile Dwellings around the Alps → Forêt de la Bettlachstock
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 83 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

It goes by way of Prehistoric Pile Dwellings around the Alps, Forêt de la Bettlachstock and back through Prehistoric Pile Dwellings around the Alps. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
